item.text:
**Diagnosis:** The recovery hook in [applications/drive](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_photos/usePhotosRecovery.ts:52) and its identical [drive-store copy](/app/packages/drive-store/store/_photos/usePhotosRecovery.ts:52) loads, waits for, counts, and checks only root children. The existing listing API provides `loadTrashedLinks` and `getCachedTrashed`; recovery does not use them. Trash results are volume wide, so recovery must select photo entries belonging to each restored share.

The move callbacks count individual failures, but a rejected load or move can leave failure and unrecovered counts inaccurate. Cleanup checks only regular children, so it can mark `SUCCEED` while targeted photos remain in trash. Persisted `progress` already triggers `STARTED`; the [existing tests](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_photos/usePhotosRecovery.test.ts:1) cover that path, but do not cover both sources or failure counts after rejected actions.

A fix should gate preparation on decryption completing for both sources, merge regular items with filtered trashed photos, and verify both sources are clear before success. **Uncertainty:** I did not run tests or verify timing against a live listing; the current tests mock decryption and movement. Per the fault-localization scope for this pass, I did not edit project source or tests.
